controles.affirmation: Le benefice net d'HII a bondi de 36,8% au deuxieme trimestre 2026, mais SUR LA MEME PERIODE la tresorerie disponible est passee de 774 M$ a seulement 12 M$ (hook)
controles.verbatim_source: Bilan 10-Q T2 2026 : "Cash and cash equivalents $ 12 [30 juin 2026] $ 774 [31 decembre 2025]". Bilan 10-Q T1 2026 : "Cash and cash equivalents $ 216 [31 mars 2026] $ 774 [31 decembre 2025]".
controles.correction_proposee: Les 774 M$ sont la position au 31 decembre 2025 : la chute a 12 M$ s'etale sur six mois, pas sur le seul deuxieme trimestre. Au 31 mars 2026 la tresorerie etait deja tombee a 216 M$. Reformuler le hook : 'le benefice net a bondi de 36,8% au deuxieme trimestre 2026, pendant qu'en six mois la tresorerie disponible passait de 774 M$ a 12 M$'. Le corps de l'ATT est correct sur ce point, seul le hook fusionne les deux periodes.

controles.affirmation: L'exploitation a consomme 421 M$ de cash au S1 2026 contre un apport de 428 M$ un an plus tot, du a un decalage defavorable du calendrier de facturation entre programmes
controles.verbatim_source: "Cash used in operating activities for the six months ended June 30, 2026, was $421 million, compared with cash provided by operating activities of $428 million for the same period in 2025. The change in operating cash flow was primarily due to an unfavorable change in trade working capital driven by the timing of billings across programs."

controles.affirmation: Aucune action rachetee ni au T1 ni au T2 2026, alors que 1,35 Mds$ restent autorises
Environ 49% du CA 2025 provenait de contrats a prix fixe (incitatif ou ferme) et 50% de contrats a cout remboursable
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "Approximately 46% of our revenues in 2025 were generated under fixed-price incentive contracts, approximately 50% were generated under cost-type contracts, approximately 1% were generated under time and material contracts, and approximately 3% were generated under firm fixed-price contracts."

controles.affirmation: Marge operationnelle segmentaire de 6,5% au T2 2026
controles.verbatim_source: Note segments 10-Q T2 2026 : "Total sales and service revenues ... 3,418" et "Total segment operating income $ 58 $ 111 $ 55 $ -- 224" (224 / 3 418 = 6,55%).

controles.affirmation: HII reconnait des situations recentes ou son personnel n'a pas atteint les gains de performance attendus, provoquant des reprises de travaux
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "We have recently experienced situations where our personnel have failed to achieve expected performance improvements on certain of our long-term contracts, which resulted in unexpected inefficiency, and in some cases, required rework, which negatively impacted our ability to achieve certain performance milestones under those contracts." ; "A growing portion of our current workforce is nearing or eligible for retirement."

controles.affirmation: Substantiellement la totalite du CA 2025 provenait de ventes au gouvernement americain
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "Substantially all of our revenues in 2025 was derived from products and services sold to the U.S. Government. We expect this to continue for the foreseeable future."

controles.affirmation: Un shutdown federal de 43 jours a eu lieu en octobre 2025, cite par HII comme facteur pouvant retarder les paiements de son client
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "When the U.S. Government fails to enact annual appropriations or a continuing resolution, a full or partial federal government shutdown may occur, as occurred in October 2025. A federal government shutdown could, in turn, result in the delay or cancellation of government programs, or the delay of payments by our customer". Duree confirmee ailleurs dans le meme 10-K : "On November 12, after a 43-day federal government shutdown, lawmakers passed and the President signed a continuing resolution".
controles.correction_proposee: Fait exact. Precision de sourcage : la duree de 43 jours ne figure pas dans la citation de l'Item 1A retenue comme 'preuve' mais dans la partie MD&A du meme 10-K. Citer les deux passages.

controles.affirmation: De plus petits chantiers navals sont recemment entres sur le marche des combattants de surface
controles.verbatim_source: 10-K FY2025, Item 1A : "We compete with another large defense contractor for contracts to build surface combatants, submarines, and large deck amphibious ships, and smaller shipyards have entered the market for surface combatants."

controles.affirmation: Carnet de commandes de 57,3 Mds$ au 30 juin 2026, +0,7% sur un an
controles.verbatim_source: 10-Q T2 2026 : "Total backlog as of June 30, 2026, and December 31, 2025, was $57.3 billion and $53.1 billion, respectively." ; 10-Q T2 2025 : "Total backlog as of June 30, 2025, and December 31, 2024, was $56.9 billion and $48.7 billion, respectively." (57,3 / 56,9 = +0,70%)
